item.title: Custom Drawstring Bag - Large Capacity Travel
item.description: Custom Drawstring Bag - Large Capacity Travel for Wholesale and Private-Label Programs Custom Drawstring Bag - Large Capacity Travel is developed for international brands, importers, retailers, distributors and promotional buyers. The reference product helps buyers compare styling and intended use while final material, dimensions, color, decoration and packing are confirmed for each order. Buyer-Focused Features and Applications Reference highlights: large-capacity format, drawstring closure. Custom development: dimensions, color, construction details, labels and packing can be adjusted to the project brief. Logo and private label: screen printing, heat transfer, embroidery, woven labels or foil methods where suitable. Typical applications: gift packaging, jewelry, cosmetics, events, retail presentation and small-item organization. Product and Customization Guide Product custom drawstring bag Material Material, weight and finish are selected to the project brief and confirmed in the quotation and approved sample. Size and color Based on the reference style or customized after feasibility and sampling review. Logo options screen printing, heat transfer, embroidery, woven labels or foil methods where suitable. Labels and packing Hangtags, woven or printed labels, barcode packing and project-specific export packing can be reviewed. MOQ and lead time Project-based and confirmed after quantity, specification, artwork, packing and production schedule review. Information Needed for an Accurate Quote Please send order quantity, finished dimensions or size range, material requirement or reference sample, colors, logo artwork and placement, packing, destination, Incoterm and target delivery date. These details allow Tendlyn Studio to confirm feasibility, sampling, MOQ, price and production timing in writing. Browse our custom drawstring bags , review the custom bag manufacturer guide and custom bag cost guide , or send your project requirements . OEM / ODM Order Process Send the brief: share intended use, quantity, specifications, artwork, packing and destination. Confirm the specification: review construction, decoration route, quotation and sampling requirements. Approve the sample: freeze measurements, color, logo placement, workmanship and packing. Produce and inspect: bulk production follows the approved standard and agreed inspection scope. Frequently Asked Questions Can this product carry our custom logo or private label? Yes. The suitable method depends on the material surface, artwork detail, logo size, number of colors, order quantity and target appearance. Vector artwork is preferred for review. What are the MOQ and production lead time? Both are project-based. Material availability, custom color, decoration, size or color split, packing and the production schedule affect the written quotation. Can we approve a sample before bulk production? Yes. Sample cost, timing, revision scope and courier charge are confirmed after the complete brief is reviewed. How are performance or sustainability claims handled? Claims such as recycled content, biodegradability, organic content, waterproof performance or regulatory compliance are only confirmed after the full material specification and supporting test documents are reviewed for the order. Request a Wholesale Quote Tendlyn Studio supports OEM / ODM development for international buyers. Contact our team for a written quotation and sample plan.
